viral_content_tips: Hook must be in first 2 seconds — text overlay on screen before audio starts
3D print timelapses consistently get 50K+ views — always worth posting
Planner aesthetic videos perform best Sunday evening and Monday morning
Use trending audio within 24-48 hours of it trending — check TikTok Creative Center daily
Caption should be conversational and ask a question to drive comments
Reply to every comment in the first hour — TikTok algorithm rewards engagement velocity
Duet/stitch popular planner videos — huge reach boost
Post consistently for 30 days before judging performance — algorithm needs data
